items.title: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
items.description: Watch: The BBC's Jonathan Beale joins Ukrainian forces taking the battle below ground and out of sight of Russian drones.

items.title: 'The drones don't fly here' - BBC reports from Ukraine's new front line

items.title: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
items.description: The three leaders will meet together for the first time on Thursday during a closely-watched summit.

items.title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
items.description: Hamas condemns the incursion, which the Israeli military says is dismantling a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.

items.title: William and Kate meet PM Modi as they wrap up India tour
items.description: The meeting in New Delhi was a late addition to the royal couple's India visit, which also included their appearance at the annual Earthshot Prize

items.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island

items.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a masterpiece, say critics
items.description: Critics have their say as to whether GTA 6, the most anticipated video game of all time, lives up to the hype.

items.title: Parents jailed for torture and death of four-year-old girl found along French motorway in 1987
items.description: Inass Touloub's body was found along the A10 road in 1987, bearing marks of abuse, and was not identified until 2018.

items.title: Ghana's new $60m presidential jet sparks public outrage
items.description: The purchase has sparked outrage over its cost as many Ghanaians struggle with rising cost of living.

items.title: British hacker who stole $11m through text message scheme jailed for six years in US
items.description: Tyler Buchanan, from Dundee, was a member of the notorious Scattered Spider group and began hacking when he was a teenager.

items.title: Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as it reports soaring sales

items.title: Waymo pulls driverless taxis from all US freeways

items.title: Rubio says US not 'under systemic attack' after series of tech outages
items.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there was "zero evidence" supporting theories online that recent disruptions affecting Microsoft, banks and flights are connected.

items.title: Irishman charged with destroying US military aircraft with axe

items.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
